name: Tabi Note
description: A calm, refined theme for small walking-tour and slow-travel agencies: a mist-mint ground with paper cards, deep ink text, deep teal headings and dark bands, and tiny amber stamp marks; Klee One handwritten-feel headings used sparingly over Noto Sans text; a two-tier header (a quiet note strip above the wordmark and menu); a home page that opens on a stamped route map with the stops of every journey; journeys with days, difficulty and prices, a day-by-day sample itinerary, the guides, a journal, a seasonal letter and an enquiry form; a deep-teal footer with a small street-map card beside the office details. The office details and the journeys with their prices are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, notes and stamp numerals (used sparingly)
body text, labels, navigation, forms and buttons
